subject: Compliance intake: ISO/FedRAMP readiness & SIG/CAIQ evidence plan
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@quantifin.co>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: security@quantifin.co
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + compliance snapshot request

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Quantifin is evaluating vendors for a regulated payments integration and we want to understand Redwood's certification roadmap. Can you share: 1) high-level timelines for ISO 27001 and any FedRAMP pursuit plans, 2) expected artifacts you can supply for a SIG/CAIQ intake (control narratives, evidence examples), and 3) recommended next steps for an evidence dry-run?

We have a tight procurement window (issuer audit in Q2 2028) so any timeline clarity helps.

Also attaching our intake template to align on fields we need filled.

Regards,
Maria Gomez
Head of Vendor Risk, Quantifin
[Attachment: quantifin-intake-template.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@quantifin.co>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance snapshot request

Hi Maria — great to connect. Short answers first, then propose a plan: 

1) Timelines: ISO 27001 — public roadmap: Q3 2028 certification target (internal pre-audit in Q2 2028). FedRAMP — exploratory stage, no official sponsorship yet; earliest pursuit would be 2029 if we secure a federal sponsor.

2) SIG/CAIQ intake: we can produce completed CAIQ sections (scope-gated), control narratives for in-scope controls, sample evidence (logs, policy PDFs, architecture diagrams). Typical deliverables we provide: control narrative spreadsheet, network-architecture-diagram.pdf, sample audit logs, and a control-matrix.csv showing mapping to our controls.

3) Dry-run suggestion: start with a 2-week intake sprint for 20 prioritized controls (your critical controls + our high-risk controls). We'll nominate control owners and drop completed artifacts into a shared folder.

Action: Can we do a 30-minute intake call tomorrow to agree on the 20-control list and owners? Proposed time: Tue 6 Dec 2027 11:00 PST.

Ben Carter
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: placeholder for our standard evidence pack]

--
Note: Internal recipients, please review and confirm we can commit the ISO Q3 2028 target publicly (Kimberly) and nominate owners for the 20-control dry-run (Monica, Aditya).

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: maria.gomez@quantifin.co
Date: Tue, 6 Dec 2027 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance snapshot request

Ben / team — confirming the ISO 27001 target: we are on track for Q3 2028 cert assuming (A) gap remediation sprint completes by end of Q1 2028, (B) external audit slots booked in Q2. FedRAMP remains exploratory as stated; please avoid definitive commitments until sponsorship is in place.

Owner nominations for the dry-run:
- Access control / IAM: Aditya Rao
- Logging & monitoring: Monica Patel
- Network segmentation: Kimberly Park (I'll lead architecture doc)

I'll attach the network diagram draft and a sanitized control-matrix excerpt to share with Quantifin for the intake.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: network-architecture-diagram.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@quantifin.co>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance snapshot request

Hi Maria — thanks Kim and team. Confirming intake call moved to Tue 6 Dec 2027 11:00 PST (joining details below). Agenda: 1) finalize 20-control sprint scope, 2) assign owners, 3) delivery format and shared folder structure, 4) timeline and turnaround expectations.

Dial-in: Zoom (link stub)

Quick note on evidence: for SIG/CAIQ we typically return a pre-filled spreadsheet for sections we control, and a short narrative for vendor-managed controls. For redlines/limitations we surface them in the control-matrix.csv.

See you in ~10.

Ben

---
On Tue, Dec 6, 2027 at 08:12, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@quantifin.co> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — 11:00 PST works for me. I'll invite my security and procurement colleagues.
>
> Maria

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@quantifin.co>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance intake follow-up & mutual action plan (MAP)

Maria — thanks for the call earlier. Below is the agreed MAP and owners. Please review and confirm; we'll start the dry-run as soon as you confirm the 20-control list.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Scope: Quantifin-specified 20 controls (attached draft) — due: 2027-12-09 (Quantifin to confirm list)
- Redwood deliverables: control narratives (per control), sample artifacts for 12 controls, completed CAIQ sections for infrastructure/network sections. Estimated delivery: staggered over two weeks after scope acceptance (first tranche 5 controls by 2027-12-16).
- Owners (Redwood):
  * Access/IAM — Aditya Rao (aditya.rao@redwood.ai)
  * Logging/Monitoring — Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai)
  * Network segmentation/architecture — Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.ai)
- Evidence handoff: secure Drive folder (link below) and a SIG-CAIQ spreadsheet for your intake team.

Attachments included for your review: SIG-quantifin-filled.xlsx (preliminary CAIQ/sections we've completed), control-matrix.csv (mapping + limitations), network-architecture-diagram.pdf.

Risks/notes: our ISO schedule could shift if major remediation is required; we'll flag any blockers within 48 hours of discovery. Also, FedRAMP sponsorship remains dependent on a federal partner — we cannot guarantee timing.

Next steps (Quantifin): confirm 20-control list by 2027-12-09 and upload any additional evidence intake requirements. (Redwood) we'll begin artifacts for the first tranche once scope is confirmed.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_shared_drive
Doc references: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/quantifin

Thanks — Ben
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
